limpia.explica:
A clean install installs {} and leaves your SD like freshly formatted, with only what the pack brings.

1. The pack is downloaded and your SD is checked. Nothing is deleted yet.
2. You see what will be removed and what stays, and choose whether to keep apps that aren't in the pack, mods and themes.
3. You confirm by holding A for three seconds. Only then is anything deleted (all logged in limpieza.log) and the pack installed.

Your games, saves, emuNAND, hekate backups and anything in preserve.txt are never touched.
limpia.explica_normal:
The normal install updates {} quickly and easily.

If you want to clean up leftover files from other packs, use the clean install.

nexus.subtitulo: Your games on a USB drive
nexus.presentacion: Move games from the SD card to a USB drive and play them from the HOME menu as usual. You free up space without deleting anything: games are copied, checked, and only then removed from the SD. Your saves stay on the console. If you unplug the USB, those games wait until you plug it back in.
nexus.quitado_por_pack: Nexus Bacán was installed, but updating the regular pack restored its Atmosphère and turned the USB off. Your games are still on the USB: reinstall it and they will open again.
nexus.tu_firmware_sub: Nexus Bacán works with the firmwares we have tested.
nexus.tu_pack_sub: It installs on top of your pack. What changes is backed up first.
nexus.disco_sub: exFAT flash drive or disk. A hard drive needs its own power supply.
nexus.instalar_sub: You can go back to the regular pack anytime, from this same section.
nexus.instalar_explica:
It installs on top of your pack:

•  Atmosphère with USB: the same as your pack, with support for games on USB.
•  The Nexus Bacán app and its Ultrahand overlay.
•  USB is turned on in the settings.

The files that change are backed up first. It is in testing: if you are not convinced, “Go back to the regular pack” leaves everything as it was and your USB games stay on the USB.

The console restarts when it finishes.
nexus.instalado_reinicia: Nexus Bacán is installed. Restart to start using it.
nexus.sin_ams: Nexus Bacán needs Atmosphère. The console probably booted another system: use your pack's Atmosphère entry and try again.
nexus.fw_no: Your firmware has not been tested with Nexus Bacán yet. When it is, it will show as compatible right here.
nexus.actualizar_sub: There is a new version. It installs like the first time; your USB games are not touched.
nexus.abrir_sub: Move games, install and check your USB.
nexus.expulsar_sin_usb: There is no USB ready to eject.
nexus.expulsar_sin_servicio: The eject request could not be sent. The console probably did not boot with Nexus Bacán's Atmosphère; restart and try again.
nexus.overlay_sub: Status, eject and reconnect without leaving the game.
nexus.overlay_sin_ultrahand: Needs Ultrahand, included in the regular pack.
nexus.overlay_texto:
Open Ultrahand with its button shortcut and choose Nexus Bacán.

•  USB status and free space.
•  Safely eject: the overlay closes and tells you when it can be unplugged.
•  Reconnect the USB: if it disconnected by accident (for example in the dock), without unplugging it.
nexus.volver: Go back to the regular pack
nexus.volver_sub: Removes Nexus Bacán. Your USB games stay on the USB.
nexus.volver_explica:
Your pack's Atmosphère is restored from the backup, USB is turned off and the Nexus Bacán app and overlay are removed.

Your USB games stay on the USB and in the HOME menu, but they won't open until you install Nexus Bacán again.

The console restarts when it finishes.
nexus.volver_reinicia: Done: you are back on the regular pack. Restart to finish.
nexus.sin_respaldo: I couldn't find your pack's backup. USB is now off in the settings; to leave everything as it was, reinstall your pack from Packs and firmwares.
nexus.guia_sub: Which drive works, moving a game and what to do if something fails.
nexus.guia_texto:
1.  Prepare the drive
exFAT. A hard drive needs its own power supply. Format it from the PC with OQB Updater PC/Mac.

2.  Move a game
Open Nexus Bacán › Your games › SD filter › X Move to USB. It is copied, checked and only then deleted from the SD.

3.  Play as usual
The game stays in the HOME menu with the USB mark. Without the USB it won't open: plug it in.

4.  Before unplugging
Safely eject (here or in the overlay). To use it again: Reconnect, or unplug it and plug it back in.

5.  If something fails
It is probably the cable or the dock port; try another. If it continues, use Diagnostics for support.

Your saves don't go to the USB: they stay on the console.
nexus.diagnostico_sub: Bundles the USB logs, SD card state, installed modules and recent errors into one file. No keys, tickets, saves or games.
nexus.diagnostico_error: The file could not be saved. The SD is probably full or write-protected.
nexus.sin_usb_sub: Plug it in and it mounts by itself in a few seconds.
nexus.sin_servicio_sub: The console probably did not boot with Nexus Bacán's Atmosphère. Restart.
nexus.caja_sd_sub: Move games to the USB to free up space.
nexus.expulsar_explica:
Nexus only ejects the USB with no game or app open, and OQB Updater is an app.

OQB Updater closes and Nexus finishes ejecting. It tells you with a notification when you can unplug it.
nexus.acceso_pregunta:
Create the Nexus Bacán shortcut on the HOME menu?

That way you open it like any other game, without going through the homebrew menu.
nexus.acceso_sub: Opens Nexus Bacán from the HOME menu, like any other game.
nexus.acceso_listo: Done: Nexus Bacán is now on the HOME menu.
nexus.pack_oc_sub: With the overclock pack, USB games don't open yet. For now, Nexus Bacán goes with the regular pack.
nexus.pack_oc_explica:
With the overclock pack, USB games don't open yet: its boot loads its own pieces that clash with Nexus Bacán. We're looking into it.

For now, install the regular pack and then Nexus Bacán. Your games and saves are not touched.
nexus.pack_oc_manual: Install the regular pack from Packs and firmware, then come back here.
nexus.acceso_rehacer_sub: Recreates it with Nexus Bacán's current icon and name.
nexus.reinstalar_sub: Downloads and installs the published version again. Your USB games are not touched.
